draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.82, the 8th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 2nd of 22 at LB. He lasted until pick 52, well after his grade rank (8th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Derwin James. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (87th percentile). College production: 61 tackles in 2020, 12th of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns (physically unable to perform). 49 career games and 41 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2024 against a career-best 11 in 2023. Strengths in 2024: tackles for loss 10 (97th percentile), sacks 3.0 (91st percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 10.3% (24th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-4 off-ball linebacker who played: 61 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
